description: UA Air Force Command monthly recap: air targets Russia launched (spokesman Yurii Ihnat, on the national telethon) set against those the Defense Forces destroyed (KPSZSU Telegram). Hand-curated. Launched figures are the spokesman's rounded, spoken numbers ('around', 'nearly', 'more than'); destroyed figures are the post's exact counts.

launched.speaker: Col. Yurii Ihnat, Head of Communications, UA Air Force Command, national joint 24/7 newscast
launched.text:
Ukraine's Air Force has reported that Russia launched more than 4,000 jet-powered drones, around 150 ballistic missiles and 80 cruise and air-launched missiles against Ukraine in October 2026.

Source: Colonel Yurii Ihnat, Head of Communications for the Ukrainian Air Force Command, on the national joint 24/7 newscast on 2 November

Quote: "Nearly 360 Banderol/Dan-T drone-launched cruise missiles of this particular type were used in October. There were also 4,740 conventional drones – meaning Shaheds, Gerberas and Parodiyas – and more than 4,000 jet-powered UAVs. Those are the statistics for October.

As for missiles, the enemy used around 150 ballistic missiles and 80 cruise and air-launched missiles."

categories.note: Zircon counted here (a hypersonic cruise missile); the spokesman's two missile buckets are only ballistic vs. cruise/air-launched.
Spokesman reports these separately from the missiles; not included in the 230 missiles.
Assumes the post's Shahed-238 line is the full jet-UAV count.

not_matched.note: No launched counterpart for reconnaissance UAVs or Lancets. Kinzhal / Kh-22 / KAB are not itemised in either source.
